verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says Jev replies in under 400ms, fast enough for real-time game-loop decisions, which supports the sub-second full-answer path. The vendor docs only give relative speed claims, such as batching questions being 10.0x faster, and never publish absolute latency figures. Missing for 10: first-party documented latency behavior (p50/p95 timings, per-model latency, latency vs. state/question size), any streaming option or explicit statement that streaming is unnecessary, and independent latency benchmarks beyond a single anecdote.
